title: MVIS may be starting to showing strength to the upside
summary: I’ve been technical screening this weekend and one that keeps being highlighted is MVIS due to multiple technical indications.200sma and 50sma have been crossing back and forth for an extended amount of time on the 4hr chart. The weekly HA candle chart has switched from bearish to neutral as of the last two week in a row with a current RSI of 39. The monthly chart has a tight bollinger band between .76 and 1.50.My plan is to keep an eye on this for 2-3 days before I make any moves. But with this technical set up, the current volume/price action increasing past average, and a continued bullish chart on the short term(1 day-15min) there may be many opportunities to trade. Key word, trade. Not invest lol.Institutions own 32%( currently double amount since Dec 2021 low).
